versions.changelog:
if-you-vanished-video-gen 1.0.1

- Added _meta.json file for improved metadata and platform compatibility.
- Minor updates to documentation in SKILL.md; no workflow or functional changes.

- Initial release of "if-you-vanished-video-gen" skill for melancholic vertical short video generation.
- Creates “if you vanished” themed videos with timed English captions and bittersweet or hopeful closers—never self-harm.
- Supports text, single image (Kling), or multi-image (Seedance) input; default video duration is 10 seconds, optionally 5 or 15.
- Requires WERYAI API key and Node.js 18+; includes CLI usage examples.
- Built-in content safety: blocks graphic or self-harm prompts, focuses on absence and loneliness themes.
- Outputs video with soft typography, quiet visuals, and optional sparse piano or room audio.
